revisions.reason: Reviewed 20261127 Node shared renderer startup: require the production RenderWorker and D3DCommandStream modules into the same globals that the existing browser importScripts route installs. Two bootstrap bindings only; no callback producer, guest reentry, queue admission, failure handling, execution or retirement change. Fresh actual GuestThreadHost/production guest-worker baseline rejects PublicationQueue access; tracked test-node-shared-render-init.cjs now runs real guest and native d3d-render-worker Workers, enqueues two real PublicationQueue descriptors and replays three native software-GL texture copies with FIFO pixel/guard assertions, rejects failed queue and malformed init, and joins physical Worker exits/clocks. Existing lifecycle/RPC/publication tests retained; broader callback ownership remains pending. Run 20261127-node-render-worker-init-repair-root; no GPU/browser qualification.
